    """Normalize: rstrip each line, drop leading/trailing blanks, collapse blank runs."""
    out = []
    blank = False
    for ln in text.split("\n"):
        ln = ln.rstrip()
        if ln == "":
            blank = True
            continue
        if blank and out:
            out.append("")
        out.append(ln)
        blank = False
    return out


def strip_pubcrate(text):
    return re.sub(r"^(\s*)pub\(crate\) (fn )", r"\1\2", text, count=1, flags=re.M)


def find_line(lines, pattern, start=0):
    for i in range(start, len(lines)):
        if re.search(pattern, lines[i]):

    return None


def brace_end(text):
    depth = 0
    in_str = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        c = text[i]
        if in_str:
            if c == "\\":
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == '"':
                in_str = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == '"':
            in_str = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif c == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:

        i += 1
    raise SystemExit("unbalanced braces")

    sig = idx

    joint = "\n".join(lines[sig:]) + "\n"

    rel = brace_end(joint[oi:]) + oi

    return lines[start : end + 1], idx - start
